select u.id, u.nickname, u.email, u.icon, u.account_status as accountStatus, u.create_time as createTime, (select count(*) from article a where a.user_id = u.id) as articleCount from user u
and (u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.email like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
and u.account_status = #{status}
